description: Parallel workers never block on an interactive ask and never retry forever (design A4; plan.md items 13-15). Today the worker retry loops are unbounded under auto-approval and ask api_req_failed / mistake_limit_reached / output-limit questions nobody answers. waitForParallelTask only settles on provider events, a lifetime abort, or a run() rejection, so a silent loop end or the async provider re-emit can mis-settle. This feature adds the Task API (parallelWorkerFailure, failParallelWorker, the parallelWorkerApiFailures counter with its reset, failWorkerIfRetriesExhausted whose FIRST line is `if (!this.parallelWorker || this.abort) return false` per round-3 NIT 2, PARALLEL_WORKER_MAX_API_RETRIES = 8), worker branches at the first-chunk, mid-stream, output-limit, empty-assistant and mistake-limit sites, the cancelReason tweaks, and waitForParallelTask's child TaskCompleted listener with settle/onLoopEnded. No taskLifecycle.ts change (workers are outside the delegation graph). Depends on FEAT-002 (the idle timeout is used by the interleaved-failure test). FEAT-004's worker escalation calls failParallelWorker added here.
steps: plan.md item 13: in src/core/task/Task.ts add the module const PARALLEL_WORKER_MAX_API_RETRIES = 8, the public field `parallelWorkerFailure?: string` (JSDoc), and `private parallelWorkerApiFailures = 0`. Add `public async failParallelWorker(reason: string)`: reject with a plain Error on non-workers; set `parallelWorkerFailure ??= reason` and `abortReason ??= 'streaming_failed'` before any await; `await this.say('error', t('common:errors.parallel_worker_failed', { reason })).catch(...)`; `await this.abortTask()`. Add `private async failWorkerIfRetriesExhausted(error: unknown): Promise<boolean>` whose first line is `if (!this.parallelWorker || this.abort) return false`; it increments the counter, returns false while `<= 8`, else awaits failParallelWorker(`API request failed after 8 retries: ${message}`) and returns true. Reset the counter next to `consecutiveNoAssistantMessagesCount = 0` (~4058).

plan.md item 13 (cancelReason): at the in-loop abort check (~3642) use `await abortStream(this.abortReason ?? 'user_cancelled')`; in the mid-stream catch (~3856) use `const cancelReason = this.abort ? (this.abortReason ?? 'user_cancelled') : 'streaming_failed'`.

plan.md item 13 (sites): (a) mistake limit (~3141), after the telemetry and before the ask: worker -> await failParallelWorker(`Stopped after ${this.consecutiveMistakeLimit} consecutive mistakes`); return true. (b) Mid-stream OutputTokenLimitError (~3870): worker -> await failParallelWorker('Model output token limit reached; the identical request would truncate again'); break. (c) Mid-stream else (~3880): after the console.error, `if (await this.failWorkerIfRetriesExhausted(error)) break`, and the backoff condition becomes `stateForBackoff?.autoApprovalEnabled || this.parallelWorker`. (d) Empty-assistant: after the MODEL_NO_ASSISTANT_MESSAGES say (~4287) and BEFORE the state read/history pop, `if (await this.failWorkerIfRetriesExhausted(new Error('The model returned no assistant messages'))) return true`; the branch at ~4310 becomes `state?.autoApprovalEnabled || this.parallelWorker`. (e) attemptApiRequest first-chunk catch, after the context-window branch: if exhausted, throw new Error(`[Task#attemptApiRequest] task ${this.taskId}.${this.instanceId} aborted after worker retry cap`); the retry branch condition becomes `autoApprovalEnabled || this.parallelWorker`.

findings:
FOR FEAT-004, failParallelWorker signature (src/core/task/Task.ts, right after abortTask(), ~2896): `public async failParallelWorker(reason: string): Promise<void>`. Behavior: (1) if `!this.parallelWorker` it throws `new Error('failParallelWorker called on a non-worker task')` (async, so the promise rejects). The presenter must guard with `cline.parallelWorker` before calling it. (2) Before any await it sets `this.parallelWorkerFailure ??= reason` and `this.abortReason ??= 'streaming_failed'`. (3) It runs `await this.say('error', t('common:errors.parallel_worker_failed', { reason })).catch(log)`, then `await this.abortTask()`. For a worker it never rejects: say errors are swallowed and abortTask is idempotent. Calling it twice keeps the first reason. After it resolves, `cline.abort === true` and lifetimeSignal is aborted. Anything in the presenter that throws afterwards is rethrown by FEAT-001's dispatch catch (its first rule is `cline.abort`), so B1 should push the tool error result FIRST, then `await cline.failParallelWorker(t('tools:toolRepetitionLimitReached', { toolName: block.name }))`, then `break`. waitForParallelTask reports this to the parent as `Worker failed: <reason>` (from both the lifetime-abort `stopped` path and onLoopEnded). The in-loop abort check (`abortStream(this.abortReason ?? 'user_cancelled')`) labels api_req_started 'streaming_failed' for a presenter-triggered worker failure during streaming (Task.parallel-worker-failure.spec.ts case 'labels a worker self-failure during streaming as streaming_failed').
PRESENTER TEST DOUBLES: presentAssistantMessage specs build plain mock tasks cast once with `as unknown as Task`. Add `parallelWorker: false` to the shared mock (the presenter reads it), and for worker cases set `parallelWorker: true` plus `failParallelWorker: vi.fn(async (_reason: string) => { mockTask.abort = true })`. Setting abort mirrors the real post-condition, so the FEAT-001 catch rethrow rule and any `cline.abort` checks behave as in production. A bare `vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined)` also works if the case does not depend on abort. Assert `expect(mockTask.failParallelWorker).toHaveBeenCalledWith(<reason>)` and `expect(mockTask.ask).not.toHaveBeenCalled()`. For non-worker cases, assert it is not called; the real method would reject. If a FEAT-004 test uses a real Task (Task.spec.ts-style preamble), copy Task.parallel-worker-failure.spec.ts createLoopTask(): `parallelWorker: true` in TaskOptions, `vi.spyOn(task, 'dispose').mockResolvedValue(undefined)` (abortTask stays real so lifetimeSignal aborts), `vi.spyOn(task, 'ask').mockRejectedValue(new Error('unexpected ask'))` so a regression fails fast instead of hanging, and `vi.spyOn(task, 'failParallelWorker')` (pass-through spy; internal `this.failParallelWorker(...)` calls hit it). Any Task-importing suite that mocks timeout-config must export both getApiRequestTimeout and getApiStreamIdleTimeout.
Other Task.ts names: `const PARALLEL_WORKER_MAX_API_RETRIES = 8` (module scope, after MAX_CONTEXT_WINDOW_RETRIES). Public field `parallelWorkerFailure?: string` and `private parallelWorkerApiFailures = 0` sit right after `readonly parallelParentTaskId`. Specs read and write the counter as `task['parallelWorkerApiFailures']`. `private async failWorkerIfRetriesExhausted(error: unknown): Promise<boolean>` follows failParallelWorker. Its first line is `if (!this.parallelWorker || this.abort) return false`. It extracts the message from an Error, else from an object's `message` property, else String(error), and fails with `API request failed after 8 retries: <message>`. The counter resets next to `consecutiveNoAssistantMessagesCount = 0` in the `hasTextContent || hasToolUses` branch. Sites: mistake limit (fail + `return true` before the ask), mid-stream OutputTokenLimitError (fail + `break` before the ask), mid-stream else (`if (await this.failWorkerIfRetriesExhausted(error)) break` after the console.error; backoff when `autoApprovalEnabled || this.parallelWorker`), empty-assistant (cap check after the MODEL_NO_ASSISTANT_MESSAGES say and BEFORE the `getState()`/pop; `return true` without popping; retry branch `state?.autoApprovalEnabled || this.parallelWorker`), and attemptApiRequest's first-chunk catch (after the context-window branch: throw `[Task#attemptApiRequest] task <id>.<instance> aborted after worker retry cap`; retry branch `autoApprovalEnabled || this.parallelWorker`). cancelReason: the in-loop abort uses `this.abortReason ?? 'user_cancelled'`, and the mid-stream catch uses `this.abort ? (this.abortReason ?? 'user_cancelled') : 'streaming_failed'`. A worker's mid-stream `break` leaves recursivelyMakeClineRequests returning false. initiateTaskLoop then exits because `this.abort` is true.
waitForParallelTask (runParallelTasks.ts): the child Pick adds 'parallelWorkerFailure' | 'on' | 'off'. A `settle(fn)` guard makes the first outcome win and runs cleanup, which also does `child.off(TaskCompleted, onChildCompleted)`. `completedText` is set by the child's own TaskCompleted, and stopped / needsInput / onLoopEnded resolve with it via resolveIfCompleted(). `workerError(fallback)` yields `Worker failed: <parallelWorkerFailure>` or the fallback. `void child.run().then(onLoopEnded, onLoopError)`. runParallelTasks is unchanged. Test doubles for the child need on/off (waitForParallelTask.spec.ts fixture: a second EventEmitter cast once to Pick<Task, 'on' | 'off'>, methods bound) and a run() that stays pending until the test resolves it.

Plan case 8 is split into 'labels a worker self-failure during streaming as streaming_failed' and 'keeps user_cancelled for a user cancel during streaming'.
